{{Quote|Turns out Fa'athra keeps interesting people on his payroll&mdash;and by 'interesting,' I mean they have prices on their heads.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] informs her [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] partner about Korkresh|audio=Mako-InterestingPeople.flac|<ref name="TOR:ABA" />}}
'''Korkresh''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was an underboss of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Voontara Fa'athra]]. Korkresh had a significant [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their head during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and in [[3643 BBY]], they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] on the grounds of [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TOR:ABA" />
